note: Static audit only. It does not play recordings, place a phone call, test speech recognition, verify Twilio/telecom callbacks, or prove that prompt semantics match the recording content.

code_risk_checks.title: Reply matching appears hard-coded to Twi
code_risk_checks.detail: audioPlaybackController.ts appears to call matchReplyToAudio with 'twi' for cleanText. Verify that English prompts and dynamic recipient readbacks cannot be replaced by Twi recordings.

code_risk_checks.title: Simulator can fall back to Twi audio
code_risk_checks.detail: PhoneSimulatorPage.tsx appears to attempt Twi after resolving the selected language. This can make an English flow play Twi.

code_risk_checks.title: Simulator may return an unresolved raw audio URL
code_risk_checks.detail: The simulator source appears to use the original audioUrl as a fallback. Check whether invalid paths are reported as errors instead of being passed to the player.

code_risk_checks.title: Review welcome and language-selection prompt separation
code_risk_checks.detail: voiceRoutes.ts contains welcome, language-selection, and GetDigits-related code. Manually verify that OP01 welcome finishes before OP02 language selection begins, rather than both being played together in one response.

code_risk_checks.title: Prompt-ID lookup may not enforce verified fixed recordings
code_risk_checks.detail: The getRecordingByPromptId lookup block does not visibly check mappingStatus/VERIFIED or recordingRole. Ensure ambiguous or unverified recordings cannot be selected for live prompts.

code_risk_checks.title: Review audio-extension rewriting
code_risk_checks.detail: ttsService.ts may rewrite an .m4a/.aac path to .mp3. Confirm that the target MP3 actually exists; do not change extensions without a real converted file.

code_risk_checks.title: Review simulator PIN authorization completion
code_risk_checks.detail: The simulator has a PIN-authorization/zero-PIN path. It should never collect the real MoMo PIN. Verify there is a test-only approval/result path or a provider status callback so the simulated transaction can continue after authorization.
